Question 18

Identify the sentence that is equivalent to the following: "x is rational, and x is less than 2 and it is rational."

a
x is rational
b
x is rational but not less than 2
c
x is neither rational nor less than 2
d
x is rational or less than 2
e
x is rational and less than 2
